text:
Alice M: Heads-up — during the 2h longctx soak (16k+ tokens) with INT8 quant enabled we see steady KV slot memory growth and increasing fragmentation. baseline (bf16) stays flat.

Ben L: repro steps? branch/env?

Alice M: run longctx-loadtest v2 (link: https://ci.internal/longctx-run/322) on rwd-runtime:main + int8-profile-3. Config: `kv.eviction_policy=adaptive`, `kv.quant_profile=int8_default`, `serve.batch.max_tokens=2048`.

Carol R: Pasted quick profiler dump from a repro run:
```
KV slots total: 1.9M
Active slots: 1.1M
Fragmented slots: 800k (avg hole 48 bytes)
Memory high-water: 8.7GB (start 4.1GB)
Compaction events: 12 (low effectiveness)
Evictions: 0.7/s (age-based)
Kernel chosen (attn): fused_attn_v2_fast_gemm
Batching heuristic: dynamic_time_window=30ms
Accuracy delta vs bf16: EM -0.9%, ppl +6.2%
```

Dan: interesting — compaction events low suggests fragmentation not being reclaimed. Could be slab->page crossover thresholds tuned for bf16 but INT8 reduces item size and changes packing.

Alice M: exactly. suspect slot packing math in `slab_allocator` doesn't account for quantized object headers + alignment changes.

perf-bot: Telemetry snapshot uploaded: https://perf-dashboard.internal/runs/2008429000/kv-drift (approved). Metric highlights: mem/growth slope +2.5MB/min, slot-unused-frac 0.41, kernel-switches spiked at sequence length boundary 4096.

Ben L: do we have kernel selection interplay? if kernel picks fast_gemm it may change per-token latency and batching which affects KV residency.

Carol R: I ran a short A/B: disable fused_attn for sequences>4096, keep int8. Results (30m): mem growth halved (1.2GB -> 2.6GB) but accuracy slightly worse vs bf16 (-1.1% EM) so not a win. suggests both allocator and kernel choice matter.

Dan: action items idea: 1) add slot_compact_threshold scaled by quantization_ratio (int8 -> smaller threshold) 2) add eviction heuristic that looks at slot_fragmentation_score not just age 3) instrument kernel-switch boundary traffic and batching sizes.

Alice M: proposed quick experiment commands:
```
# quick config override on canary
rwdctl set-config runtime.kv.slot_compact_threshold=0.6
rwdctl set-config runtime.kv.fragmentation_eviction=true
rwdctl set-config runtime.kernel.fallback_seq_boundary=8192
```

Ben L: i'll run a 3h canary with those toggles on a dedicated pool. will collect slot maps + heap snapshots every 15m.

Carol R: also record model quality checks (eval set) every 30m — we need to correlate recall drift with specific eviction/compaction events. add `evalhook.enable=true` to canary.

Dan: note: watch out for wear-leveling on INT8 quant slots (observed in other clusters) — compaction frequency can regress inference quality if it forces hot keys out. set `kv.eviction_burst_limit=5` during experiment.

Alice M: assigning owners: Ben running canary, Carol on perf analysis, Dan on allocator tweaks. pinging @Dan for quick patch. :thumbsup:

Dan: will open small PR to scale slot_compact_threshold by `1.0 + (1 - quant_size_ratio)` and add a debug flag to dump slot_free_list after each compaction.

Ben L: started canary 2008429020; will post first heap snapshot in ~15m.

perf-bot: Canary started: group=kv-int8-slot-tuning, id=canary-2008429020. Link: https://perf-dashboard.internal/canaries/canary-2008429020

Alice M: thanks team — main goal: eliminate sustained mem slope while keeping EM drop <0.5% vs bf16. We'll reconvene after first 3h run.

Carol R: one more note — observed small but consistent increase in `kv.page_cache_miss` after compaction events; may be warmup/regeneration cost. track p95 latency too.

Ben L: ack, will include p50/p95/p99 and model eval deltas in logs.

Alice M: closing loop: if canary stable, we'll rollback fused_attn tweak and ship allocator change to next canary.

Dan: cc @eng-runtime for visibility.
